sections.heading: Packaging Designed for the First 3 Seconds of Video
sections.text: Seeding Campaign Packaging Packaging Designed for the First 3 Seconds of Video A PR box has one audience: the camera. The lid-lift is the thumbnail; the first three seconds decide whether the unboxing gets posted or skipped. We design for that moment — foil artwork that catches ring-light, ribbon that pulls away in one motion, and trays that stage products face-up at a 15° camera angle. Everything is colour-choreographed: box, crinkle, tissue, ribbon and thank-you card matched to one palette so every frame is on-brand. Inserts hold hero product centre-stage with minis orbiting — no loose items rolling out of frame. MOQ 100 matches real seeding lists. Add a personalisation slot for the influencer's name card. See how it connects to the wider unboxing experience playbook or the velvet ribbon format .

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What makes a PR box different from a normal gift box? It's engineered for video: foil that reads under ring-light, one-pull ribbon, and a tray that stages products at a 15° camera angle so the opening shot frames itself. Can each box carry the influencer's name? Yes — a name-card slot with variable-name printing lets every recipient see their own name on opening, without changing the box tooling. Can crinkle and tissue match our brand colour? Yes, crinkle, tissue, ribbon and card are colour-matched to one palette reference so every frame of the unboxing stays on-brand. What is the MOQ for PR kits? 100 kits — sized to real seeding lists rather than factory-convenient volumes. Samples in 3–5 business days. Can you produce recurring campaign waves? Yes, tooling is stored so wave 2+ reorders skip setup fees and ship in 10–12 days.
